body:
[A10] Non-blocking findings of the two independent reviews of PR #459 (#398), taken out of that lane as its follow-up. The merged head is correct: both reviewers built the RV32 firmware for the shipping 1x1 and a CRF-off variant and found exactly one store to offset 1872 (0x750), 3 and 0 respectively, and none to 0x614.

## What no gate sees today

1. A `CRFT_CTRL` (0x750) or `ADP_CAPS` (0x614) store made outside `configure_fabric()`. Gate 35 enters the firmware through `configure_fabric()` alone; gate 1b censuses the entity-enable bits by address, not 0x750. Both reviewers planted `milan_write(MILAN_CRF_TX_CTRL, 3u);` in `entity_advertise()`: gate 35, gate 1b and `check_baremetal_only.py --check` all stayed green. That is the failure acceptance 1 of #398 names.
2. The publication hop in `sw/litex/milan_soc.py` (the three-line loop that hands `boot_policy.fabric_constants()` to `add_constant`) is held by text pins only. A planted `3 if _name.endswith("CTRL_BOOT") else _value` stayed green: a CRF-off config would get a firmware that enables the talker.
3. Four of the five NVM wait values can move with every gate green (heartbeat 250 to 300, erase 3500 to 3200, program 50 to 20, restore 3000 to 2000); only the debounce is refused, by the host test.
4. `docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md` row 30 cites the `MAC_CTRL` write one line off (#403 takes that row). `tb/verilator/pp_shadow/sim_main.cpp` still provisions 0x614 and rebuilds its expected ADPDU from the readback; the expected word belongs to the package constant.

## Acceptance

1. A whole-firmware statement for the two addresses: exactly one store to 0x750, the generated one, and none to 0x614 (the by-address census gate 1b keeps for 0x920 and 0x600 is the pattern), or a host run that enters through `milan_init()`. The plant of item 1 turns the suite red.
2. The value the publication loop emits for each key is measured or pinned (a pin on the loop body, or an elaboration arm reading `soc.h` where LiteX is present). The plant of item 2 turns the suite red.
3. The five wait values are pinned beside their bounds, or the word "unchanged" leaves the `WRITER_TIMING_MS` comment.
4. The pp_shadow bench takes its expected capability word from `pp_adp_pkg`; docs gates pass; no em dash on added lines.

Serialise with #408 and #409: all three edit gate 1b and `test_builder.py`.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
title: [Boot gate] Gate 35 measures configure_fabric() only: a CRFT_CTRL store elsewhere, or a wrong value published by milan_soc.py, stays green
